recognize_zh: 低倍率 H&E 脾臟切片呈瀰漫性紅髓浸潤，整片被單一形態的小到中型淋巴樣細胞充滿，其間散布大量紅血球湖（blood lakes），看不到白髓濾泡結節；紅髓瀰漫浸潤是毛細胞白血病及其變異型在脾臟的特徵。
features: Diffuse, uniform cellular infiltrate throughout the field without identifiable white pulp nodules
Monotonous small to intermediate cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Numerous small irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes/pseudosinuses)
Red pulp cords and sinuses obscured by the infiltrate
No necrosis or granulomas evident at this magnification
describe_en: Section of spleen at low power shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. Numerous small irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes) are scattered throughout, and white pulp follicles are not identified in this field. There is no necrosis or granulomatous inflammation. Findings are consistent with diffuse red pulp involvement by a small B-cell neoplasm, in context hairy cell leukemia variant; immunohistochemistry is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: SMZL primarily expands the white pulp as biphasic nodules with marginal zone differentiation, with only secondary red pulp involvement.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL has an identical red pulp pattern and requires immunophenotype (CD103, CD123, CD25, annexin A1) and cytology for separation.
HSTCL infiltrates red pulp sinusoids with CD3+ gamma-delta T cells and lacks B-cell markers.
EMH shows trilineage precursors including megakaryocytes and erythroid islands rather than a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate.
